name: Expansion-history models fitted to the Pantheon+ supernova Hubble diagram
description: Propose a parametric expansion history E(z) = H(z)/H0 with at most six parameters and fit it to the 1,580 Pantheon+ Type Ia supernova light curves with zHD > 0.01 (the 1,590-object cosmology sample minus the ten Cepheid-host calibrators) (corrected apparent magnitudes and the full statistical plus systematic covariance). The absolute magnitude is profiled analytically; the score is the minimum chi-squared, lower is better. Flat LambdaCDM with a fitted matter density is reported for comparison.

sources.locator: Brout et al. 2022, The Pantheon+ Analysis: Cosmological Constraints; Section 2 (data), Section 3 (likelihood with the STAT+SYS covariance, zHD > 0.01 cut).
Pantheon+SH0ES.dat and Pantheon+SH0ES_STAT+SYS.cov, fetched by scripts/prepare_science_data.py and pinned by SHA-256.

requirements.datasets: None downloaded; mathematical constructions or locally generated synthetic instances.

evaluation.benchmark: Expansion-history models fitted to the Pantheon+ supernova Hubble diagram
evaluation.paper_metric: Local protocol; see candidate contract and source adaptation notes

execution.interface: expansion(z, theta) -> array E(z) = H(z)/H0 for an array of redshifts z >= 0 (positive, finite; E(0) should be 1); initial_theta() -> initial parameter vector (1 to 6 values); bounds() -> list of (low, high) per parameter. The evaluator fits theta to the Pantheon+ Hubble diagram (zHD > 0.01 and no Cepheid calibrators: 1,580 light curves, STAT+SYS covariance) with the absolute magnitude profiled analytically and H0 = 70 fixed for the distance scale; score is the minimum chi-squared (lower is better). Flat LambdaCDM (fitted Omega_m) chi-squared is reported for comparison.

limitations: Real measurements: the data are the public Pantheon+ release, fetched at prepare time (network), not redistributed.
The likelihood profiles the absolute magnitude and fixes H0 = 70 for the distance scale, so only the shape of E(z) is constrained; the SH0ES Cepheid calibrators are excluded.

A lower chi-squared than LambdaCDM with more parameters is not by itself evidence for new physics; model comparison needs an information criterion or Bayesian evidence, which the evaluator reports the ingredients for (chi-squared and parameter count).

papers.title: The Pantheon+ Analysis: Cosmological Constraints
papers.task_relation: The local task fits a bounded-complexity expansion history to a selected set of Pantheon+ light curves with covariance and a profiled magnitude offset. Its Cepheid-host exclusion, parameter cap, and chi-square objective do not reproduce the full combined cosmological analysis.
papers.primary_goal: Use the Pantheon+ supernova sample to infer cosmological parameters, including dark-energy properties.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Constrain cosmic expansion and dark energy using Type Ia supernova distance measurements.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Inferring cosmological parameters from supernova observations is the primary goal of the Pantheon+ cosmology analysis.
science_relevance.reason: The chosen source is the cosmological-inference paper, not merely the Pantheon+ data-release paper.
